Class Observer

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.Observer
final class Observer extends Object
Builds the two views of a moment in the game: the observation the agent acts on (pixels and its own body) and the ground truth used only to score it. Keeping both in one place makes it easy to check that nothing from the second leaks into the first.
